title: Two websites at once
summary: Run two different web servers side by side, each behind its own door.

tasks.title: `site-one` runs nginx and opens on `http://localhost:8091`
tasks.hint: nginx listens on port 80 inside its container: `docker run -d --name site-one -p 8091:80 nginx`.

tasks.title: `site-two` runs httpd and opens on `http://localhost:8092`
tasks.hint: httpd (Apache) also listens on port 80 inside its container. Only the laptop's door must be different: `-p 8092:80`. The image is called `httpd`.

tasks.title: Both are running at the same time
tasks.hint: `docker ps` should list `site-one` and `site-two`. If one stopped, `docker logs <name>` tells you why.
